notes.title: UZG REMASTERED PLAYTEST IS HERE
notes.notes:
[p][b]IT IS FINALLY TIME.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The playtest has finally started. The playtest is going to go on for a long time. (No ETA) I'm mainly looking for feedback on the core gameplay. I'm always in need of ideas and new things to add. Bugs are also important, so any bugs you find, please report them via the in-game menu or in Discord. As for adding new maps, they will come... eventually. I want the game to feel polished and the core gameplay to feel nice before going crazy adding new maps. Anyways, enough yapping, I hope you enjoy the game.[/p][p]
[/p]
